items.title: The Forgotten Field
items.synopsis:
I pray every dayfor this love to die.
That I may love you only until today,
and by tomorrow, may this love be dead.

-Born of an affair, the ill-fated imperial princess Thalia Roem Guirta.

She grows up twisted beneath the neglect of indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings,
and servants who look upon her with contempt.
To survive, Thalia learns to protect herself by baring her thorns at everyone who comes near.
And yet, even she becomes utterly defenseless before one man.

That man is Varkas Raedgo Seorkan, the noble young lord of the East.

A vassal of the imperial family and heir to a grand duke,
he was raised under relentless pressure to be perfect.
Shaped by discipline so harsh it bordered on abuse,
he grew up with most of his emotions long since numbed.
A man who exists solely for his family’s honor and duty.

To keep a promise made to the late empress,
he becomes engaged to Ayla, Thalia’s half-sister.

And Thalia, consumed by despair, begins to slowly break apart.

But then—

the love fated to end in her death reaches an unexpected turning point….

items.title: The Forgotten Fiancée
items.synopsis:
After one-night sleep, Canying totally forgets Huizhen, his fiancée and everything that is related to her. The wedding ceremony has to be postponed due to his memory loss. Heartbroken as Huizhen is, she has to brace herself up and face the suspicious gaze from her mother-in-law, the indifference of the former loving fiancé, and the schemed woman who's trying to use the opportunity to break their marriage...

items.title: Forgotten Juliet
altTitles: ジュリエットが消えた夜
items.synopsis:
In the north, Duke Lennox Carlyle, born with blessings and misfortune, always lived by simple rules: take what he wanted and discard what was no longer useful. Among the discarded was his contract with Juliet Monad, the fallen young countess who, seven years ago, came to him offering love at first sight in exchange for revenge. Now, after a farewell that hurt him like the sharpest dagger, fate grants them a second life marked by secrets, betrayals, and a new contract. This time, Juliet is not looking for love, but to use and be used until she ends the relationship on her own terms. But in a game of cat and mouse, neither the past nor forgotten promises will remain hidden for long.

items.title: The Long-Forgotten Name
items.synopsis: A strange girl with bunny ears suddenly broke into Xiaolin’s life, and accused her of forgetting her name… During the days Xiaolin spent with the bunny girl, familiar situations and phrases gradually made Xiaolin remember fragments of things hidden deep in her memories, at which point the bunny girl suddenly disappeared… Can Xiaolin remember the long-forgotten name and the buried dream, and will the two of them meet again?

items.synopsis: Kuhei, who works as a guard at the Rokkaku Prison House (currently a prison) in Kyoto, has a mysterious ability. One day, he meets a moneylender called Kon. She is a stingy girl, but she ends up having a physical relationship with her virginity...!?

items.title: Forgotten Juliet
items.synopsis:
“Your Highness, there’s something I’d really like for my birthday.”

“What is it?”

“Will you promise to listen?”

Then the man blatantly laughed.

But who would point out his arrogance – a young Northern Duke who’s not even afraid of the Emperor? He could even get a throne if he wished for it.

But it was just a sweet lover’s birthday wish.

“Alright. I swear.”

So, Juliet spoke lightly,

“Please break up with me. I don’t love you anymore.”

A fiance just for show. A succession of meaningless nights.

Now is the time to end seven years of unrequited love.

items.title: Field Trip
items.synopsis: Jong Hyun Ho has an unusual ability. He has the ability to read peoples thoughts when he is touched by them. But having this ability is not all fun and games. Jong Hyun Ho finds this ability very troublesome, and he doesn't like being near people. His ultimate goal is to make a lot of money and be rich and alone all his life. But one day a Shinigami appears, popping out his computer screen and proposing a job which he needs to fulfill in order to keep his soul.

items.title: Killing Field
items.synopsis:
"Once you’re in, the only way out is death!"

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he’d left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage.

But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers.

And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too.

With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

items.title: AR ~ Forgotten Summer
items.synopsis:
The memory in the window, the swaying greenery  
– That last summer, already lost –  
A single tear moves the heart, small lips and soft whispers  
– This world is beautiful –  
Sweet aroma, soft warmth, guarding you gently as you sleep with your innocent smile  
– Here… … waiting –  
Because I have you, and this memory…guarding me.  
  
Based on the visual novel of the same name by Circus.

items.title: A Dream Forgotten
items.synopsis: Life is a continuous cycle of endless dreaming and countless choices. Lucky are those who discovered their dreams early in life, but it is never too late for those who still haven’t. Kaden dreams of being a singer; Layza is still finding hers. When two people in pursuit of their place in this world grow closer together, what will happen when life is hell-bent on keeping them farther apart from one another? One thing is for sure: no one gets out unscathed.

items.title: The Forgotten Princess Just Wants Peace
altTitles: The Forgotten Princess Wants To Live In Peace
items.synopsis:
Eluana Vita Spess is a stubborn girl who works as a blacksmith in a village called Aden and raises her little brother by herself.

On the day she receives her alchemy ability, a man in the portrait that her mother cherished came up to her.

‘I’m the young lady of a Ducal family?’

Then she learned a shocking revelation from the Duke as he hugged her in his arms. She’s the last bloodline of the first emperor, all known to have been executed.

“I need to get rid of all the dangers. Because I’m worth it.”

---
I'm the daughter of a Duke?!
While locked up in a prison cell, Eluana Vita awakens her alchemy powers and later finds out she's the daughter of a Duke! However, she's in for a rude awakening when she realizes the royal life isn't what she thought it'd be. Join Eluana on her journey to find the peaceful life she's always wanted.

---

items.title: A Tactical Genius on the Field
items.synopsis: If there is one thing that Ma Jungwoo is good at, it's football. Although he is a genius strategist, others look down on him because of his lack of education and debt. But things seem to turn around when he finds out he has just inherited his late grandfather's British football team. He plans to sell the team and start fresh, only to find out the team has massive debt! Left with no other choice, Jungwoo must use his tactical genius to help this team rise from the ashes and be number one!

items.title: The Calling
items.synopsis:
An adaptation of Patricia A. McKillip's "The Forgotten Beasts of Eld."

16 years old when a baby is brought to her to raise, Sybel has grown up on Eld Mountain. Her only playmates are the creatures of a fantastic menagerie called there by wizardry. Sybel has cared nothing for humans, until the baby awakens emotions previously unknown to her. And when Coren- the man who brought this child- returns, Sybel's world is again turned upside down.
